text_block_list.text: The final day of summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
So this is where you were.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There is something I wish to give you.
choice_data_list: Pisa... Or rather, what is that?

text_block_list.text:
A flower crown resting on her head.
What in the world happened, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I actually knitted this just a little while ago.
And so... here's a matching one for you.
"—And with that, a predominantly green crown was placed atop her head."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...*ahem*
We have worked very hard
this summer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, in recognition of those efforts,
I hereby award you this summer's Fighting Spirit Prize.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"One last push.
Let's do our best together, ...okay?"
